_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: taking an image ad that already exists and regenerating it in other ratios (a named size, a ratio family, or every size a channel takes). Should-not-trigger: making an ad that doesn't exist yet (generating-image-ads), writing the ad's words (writing-ad-copy), deciding what to make (planning-campaigns), video work, and an off-topic control.
